quiz_questions.question: What does 'believing in yourself' mean?
options: Thinking you are better than everyone else
Trusting that you can do things even when they are hard
Only doing things you already know how to do
Waiting for others to do things for you
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Trusting that you can do things even when they are hard
quiz_questions.explanation: Believing in yourself means having confidence that you can learn, grow, and succeed — even when something is difficult or new.

quiz_questions.question: Chidi wants to raise his hand in class but feels scared. What should he do?
options: Stay quiet and never try
Take a deep breath and raise his hand anyway
Copy whatever his neighbour says
Wait until he is perfect before trying
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Take a deep breath and raise his hand anyway
quiz_questions.explanation: Believing in yourself means trying even when you feel scared. Taking a breath and trying anyway builds confidence over time.

quiz_questions.question: Which of these famous Nigerians showed great belief in themselves?
options: Someone who gave up at the first difficulty
Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, who kept writing and became a world-famous author
Someone who only did what others told them to do
Someone who never tried anything new
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, who kept writing and became a world-famous author
quiz_questions.explanation: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie believed in her writing talent and kept working hard. She became one of the world's most celebrated authors — proof that believing in yourself leads to great things.

quiz_questions.question: You try something new and make a mistake. What should a confident person do?
options: Give up immediately
Cry and never try again
Learn from the mistake and try again
Blame someone else
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Learn from the mistake and try again
quiz_questions.explanation: Confident people understand that mistakes are part of learning. They learn from what went wrong and try again instead of giving up.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: You must be perfect at something before you can try it.
options: True
False
quiz_questions.correct_answer: False
quiz_questions.explanation: Nobody starts out perfect! Believing in yourself means being willing to try, make mistakes, learn, and improve. Waiting until you are perfect means you will never start.

quiz_questions.question: What does 'speaking up' mean?
options: Shouting as loudly as possible
Expressing your thoughts, needs, or feelings clearly and confidently
Only speaking when an adult tells you to
Repeating what others say
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Expressing your thoughts, needs, or feelings clearly and confidently
quiz_questions.explanation: Speaking up means having the courage to share your ideas, ask for help, or say how you feel — clearly and respectfully.

quiz_questions.question: Ngozi does not understand the lesson. What should she do?
options: Pretend she understands and say nothing
Raise her hand and ask the teacher to explain again
Copy from her neighbour
Go home early
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Raise her hand and ask the teacher to explain again
quiz_questions.explanation: Speaking up means asking for help when you need it. Teachers are there to help — asking questions is a sign of courage and intelligence, not weakness.

quiz_questions.question: Someone does something that hurts your feelings. What is the confident thing to do?
options: Say nothing and feel sad inside
Hit them
Calmly tell them how their action made you feel
Tell everyone except that person
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Calmly tell them how their action made you feel
quiz_questions.explanation: Speaking up for yourself means calmly and respectfully expressing how you feel. Saying 'When you did that, it hurt my feelings' is confident and mature.

quiz_questions.question: Why is it important to speak up in class?
options: To show off to your classmates
Because the teacher forces you to
Because sharing your ideas helps you learn and helps others learn too
It is not important
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Because sharing your ideas helps you learn and helps others learn too
quiz_questions.explanation: When you speak up in class, you deepen your own understanding and your ideas might help a classmate understand too. Everyone learns better when ideas are shared.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Speaking up is only for adults — children should stay quiet.
options: True
False
quiz_questions.correct_answer: False
quiz_questions.explanation: Children have important thoughts, ideas, and feelings that deserve to be heard. Speaking up respectfully is a skill children should practise from an early age.

quiz_questions.question: Why is trying new things important for growth?
options: It is not important — stick to what you know
Trying new things helps us discover talents, learn skills, and grow stronger
Only adults should try new things
New things are always dangerous
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Trying new things helps us discover talents, learn skills, and grow stronger
quiz_questions.explanation: Every skill you have now was once new to you. Trying new things is how we discover what we are good at and develop abilities we never knew we had.

quiz_questions.question: Emeka has never played football before. His friends invite him to join. What should he do?
options: Refuse because he might not be good
Say yes and try — he might enjoy it and improve with practice
Only watch and never play
Wait until he is an expert before joining
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Say yes and try — he might enjoy it and improve with practice
quiz_questions.explanation: Trying new things — even when you might not be good at first — is how we discover new interests and develop skills. Everyone starts as a beginner!

quiz_questions.question: What feeling is normal when you are about to try something new?
options: Complete confidence with no nervousness at all
A little nervousness or excitement — and that is okay!
Anger
Feeling sleepy
quiz_questions.correct_answer: A little nervousness or excitement — and that is okay!
quiz_questions.explanation: Feeling a little nervous before trying something new is completely normal and healthy. That feeling means you care about doing well. Brave people try anyway despite feeling nervous.

quiz_questions.question: Which Nigerian saying best matches the lesson of trying new things?
options: 'Stay where you are comfortable always'
'He who does not try, does not know what he can do'
'Only try things your parents have done before'
'New things are for other people, not for you'
quiz_questions.correct_answer: 'He who does not try, does not know what he can do'
quiz_questions.explanation: This saying captures the truth that we discover our own abilities by trying. You will never know what you are capable of if you never attempt new things.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: If you try something new and are not good at it immediately, it means you should never try it again.
options: True
False
quiz_questions.correct_answer: False
quiz_questions.explanation: Being bad at something at first is completely normal — it is just the beginning of learning! With practice and persistence, you can improve at almost anything you try.

quiz_questions.question: What is the best thing to do after making a mistake?
options: Hide and pretend it did not happen
Blame someone else
Understand what went wrong and try to do better next time
Give up on the activity forever
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Understand what went wrong and try to do better next time
quiz_questions.explanation: Mistakes are valuable teachers. The best response is to think about what went wrong, learn from it, and use that knowledge to do better next time.

quiz_questions.question: Adaeze spells a word wrong in class and everyone notices. How should she respond?
options: Cry and refuse to try again
Acknowledge the mistake, learn the correct spelling, and try again confidently
Never answer questions in class again
Pretend she meant to spell it that way
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Acknowledge the mistake, learn the correct spelling, and try again confidently
quiz_questions.explanation: Acknowledging a mistake, learning from it, and moving on confidently is the mature and brave response. Everyone makes spelling mistakes — what matters is how you handle it.

quiz_questions.question: Which of these people showed great learning from mistakes?
options: Someone who gave up after one failure
Thomas Edison, who failed thousands of times before inventing the light bulb
Someone who never made any mistakes
Someone who hid their mistakes from everyone
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Thomas Edison, who failed thousands of times before inventing the light bulb
quiz_questions.explanation: Thomas Edison reportedly said 'I have not failed — I have found 10,000 ways that won't work.' He treated every failure as a lesson on the way to success.

quiz_questions.question: What does it mean to have a 'growth mindset'?
options: Believing your intelligence is fixed and cannot change
Believing that abilities can grow through effort and learning from mistakes
Believing only clever children can succeed
Believing mistakes should be hidden
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Believing that abilities can grow through effort and learning from mistakes
quiz_questions.explanation: A growth mindset means believing that intelligence and abilities are not fixed — they grow through effort, practice, and learning from mistakes. Every mistake is a step forward.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Making mistakes means you are not intelligent.
options: True
False
quiz_questions.correct_answer: False
quiz_questions.explanation: Making mistakes is part of being human and part of learning. The most intelligent and successful people in history made many mistakes. What matters is learning from them and persisting.

quiz_questions.question: Why is it important to celebrate your successes?
options: It is not important — just move on to the next task
Celebrating builds confidence, motivates you to keep trying, and acknowledges your hard work
Only big achievements deserve celebration
Celebrating is showing off and is rude
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Celebrating builds confidence, motivates you to keep trying, and acknowledges your hard work
quiz_questions.explanation: Celebrating successes — big and small — reinforces positive behaviour, builds self-confidence, and motivates you to keep working hard toward future goals.

quiz_questions.question: Kemi finally learned to ride a bicycle after many attempts. How should she celebrate?
options: Say nothing because it was too small an achievement
Feel proud, share the good news with family, and enjoy the moment
Immediately start worrying about the next challenge
Pretend it was easy and she was not proud
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Feel proud, share the good news with family, and enjoy the moment
quiz_questions.explanation: Learning to ride a bicycle after many tries is a real achievement worth celebrating! Feeling proud and sharing good news with loved ones is healthy and natural.

quiz_questions.question: What is the difference between celebrating success and boasting?
options: There is no difference
Celebrating is sharing joy and gratitude; boasting is putting others down to make yourself look better
Boasting is always better
Celebrating is only for adults
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Celebrating is sharing joy and gratitude; boasting is putting others down to make yourself look better
quiz_questions.explanation: Healthy celebration shares your joy and thanks those who helped you. Boasting makes others feel bad by comparing yourself to them. Celebrate yourself without diminishing others.

quiz_questions.question: How do Nigerians typically celebrate achievements like school graduation or passing exams?
options: Quietly alone with no one else
With family gatherings, food, music, prayers, and thanksgiving
By immediately starting the next challenge without acknowledging the achievement
By buying expensive gifts only
quiz_questions.correct_answer: With family gatherings, food, music, prayers, and thanksgiving
quiz_questions.explanation: Nigerian culture celebrates achievements with joyful family gatherings, sharing food, music, dancing, and thanksgiving prayers. These celebrations strengthen family bonds and motivate future success.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Only big achievements like winning a competition deserve to be celebrated — small achievements do not matter.
options: True
False
quiz_questions.correct_answer: False
quiz_questions.explanation: Every achievement matters — reading your first word, making a new friend, finishing your homework, learning a new skill. Celebrating small wins builds the confidence and momentum that lead to big achievements.
